project_layer.onCreateCommand:
mkdir -p ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/.devcontainer/shell && printf 'ORDER="$ORDER p10"
export SHELL_DIRS_MARKER=project
' > ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/.devcontainer/shell/10-a.sh && printf 'ORDER="$ORDER p20"
alias projalias=true
' > ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/.devcontainer/shell/20-b.sh && printf 'ORDER="$ORDER nope"
' > ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/.devcontainer/shell/notes.txt

both_layers.onCreateCommand:
mkdir -p ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/.devcontainer/shell /tmp/myshell && printf 'ORDER="$ORDER proj"
export WINNER=project
' > ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/.devcontainer/shell/10-a.sh && printf 'ORDER="$ORDER user"
export WINNER=user
export USER_LAYER=1
' > /tmp/myshell/10-a.sh
